title: Signal Reversal

story.briefing: The playback head in this archive runs backwards. Give it the stream in the order it expects, or the recordings stay unreadable.
story.success: Playback restored. Decades of logs become legible again.

description: Given an array of integers, return a new array containing the same values in reverse order. The original array should not be modified. An empty array reverses to an empty array.
hints: The last element becomes first. That relationship between an old index and a new index is the whole problem.
You can walk the input backwards and append, or walk forwards and prepend. One of those two is far cheaper on a long array — think about what prepending costs.
Loop i from the last index down to 0, pushing each element onto a new array, then return that array. Walking backwards and appending keeps every step cheap.
